verdict.rationale: Gusto's own press release states that developers and power users can 'install the Gusto CLI in one command' alongside its MCP server, framed within its AI-tool connectivity push. That is a first-party claim of an official CLI, but it is a single thin mention with no detail on commands, scope, or agent workflows. Missing for 10: CLI documentation (commands, auth, install instructions), evidence of which payroll/HR operations it exposes, explicit AI-agent usage guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
